clientToken.description: Unique, case-sensitive identifier you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request.

disableApiTermination.description: If you set this parameter to true, you can't terminate the instance using the Amazon EC2 console, CLI, or API; otherwise, you can.

ebsOptimized.description: Indicates whether the instance is optimized for EBS I/O.

imageId.description: The ID of the AMI, which you can get by calling DescribeImages.

keyName.description: The name of the key pair.

maxCount.description: The maximum number of instances to launch.

minCount.description: The minimum number of instances to launch.

ramDiskId.description: The id of the RAM disk.

securityGroupIds.description: One or more security group IDs.

securityGroups.description: One or more security group names.

subnetId.description: One or more security group names.

userData.description: The Base64-encoded MIME user data for the instances.
